body:
I think this is an improvement; we don't want a plain C header in all our files for ambiguity reasons. But I'd definitely keep the comment there. Using the plain C header in MinGW is just a workaround, and it should be fixed eventually.

Though, going back up the RC thread, it's kind of questionable we're making decisions because the `.rc` file fails compilation here. Maybe there's a better way to fix the issue entirely (avoid the include?), and resolve the problem for good.
